description:
I discuss Neil Postman's classic book on how electronic media have killed public discourse.

[1] First Kennedy-Nixon debate - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AYP8-oxq8ig 
[2] Nixon's "Checkers Speech" - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JpWwgwytdzk  
[3] Strolling the Beach - https://fortworthprsa.org/shoring-up-the-base/ 
[4] Kennedy-Nixon Debates - https://www.history.com/topics/us-presidents/kennedy-nixon-debates
[5] Organ size in the Republican Debate - https://www.cnn.com/2016/03/03/politics/donald-trump-small-hands-marco-rubio/index.html
[6] Lincoln-Douglas Debates - https://www.nps.gov/liho/learn/historyculture/debates.htm
[7] First Trump/Biden Debate - https://www.cnbc.com/2020/09/29/first-presidential-debate-highlights-trump-vs-biden-.html
[8] Hehmant Mehta and Tony Perkinds in a discussion they're not qualified for. -  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ai-z-N5eXYs
[9] "I ain't afraid of no ghost" - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lw79cQM7JfY
[10] The Meme as Discussion - https://pittnews.com/article/114752/opinions/columns/meme-culture-barrier-online-discussion/
